notes:
Based on what I found on Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's own pages, here are real toddler options running this fall:

**Pick 1: Tot Gym (Kindergym for Toddlers), Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre**
- Age fit: 
18 months - 3.11 yrs, for the toddler who loves to be on the move

- When: 
Fall Session: Sept 10 - Dec 16 (no classes Oct 10)
, and on the drop-in schedule specifically 
Thursdays 9:30 am - 12:00pm

- Price: 
Cost: $15, one parent/up to 4 children. No pre-registration necessary and payment can be made in
 person
- Source: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre

**Pick 2: Preschool & Kinderfun Drop-In, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre**
- Age fit: 
Come bring your busy preschool aged child (under 4) to one of our fun-filled drop ins
, where 
parents will stay with their child while their child explores our gymnastics equipment, bouncing on the trampoline, swinging on the bars, tumbling down the cheese or jumping in the pit

- When: 
this program only runs during the school year (Sept-Jun) and follows the same schedule as recreational programs, October 9 to June 26

- Source: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre

One caveat worth flagging to the parent: the HHGC pages mix session dates across multiple program blocks (some show Sept 7 start, others Sept 10, others Sept 12), so the exact first day for the toddler class is worth double-checking directly with the gym before registering. I did not find a separate Town of Halton Hills municipal toddler gymnastics program (the town's own children's programs page lists dance for ages 2-6, but doesn't name a gymnastics class), so HHGC is the clear find here.
